items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: Coych and, uh, West End Hose. ... That's the fella, that's the band, too, Chink, Martin, and all is on there.

ctx.x: He was, he was, uh, he used to call us up all the time, poor fella. He was so sick all the time. And he called me off. Okay.
I'm going to say Blottsy, Mississippi. Blottsy, Mississippi. Coych and, uh, West End Hose. Coych and, uh, what's his name, mother?
Hmm? Uh, Gussie Zinneman and, um, uh, what's his name?
